blocks.text: Yeh chapter 1 (Periodic Table and Periodic Properties) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, equations, zaroorat ho to diagram), aur chapter ke numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Describe the contributions of Döbereiner, Newlands, Mendeleev and Lothar Meyer to the classification of elements. (4 marks)
(Elements ki taqseem mein Döbereiner, Newlands, Mendeleev aur Lothar Meyer ke kaam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Döbereiner (1829): milti julti properties wale elements ko triads (teen ke group) mein rakha. Darmiyani element ka atomic weight baqi do ki average ke qareeb tha, maslan Li (7), Na (23), K (39): (7 + 39) ÷ 2 = 23.

Newlands (1864): pehli dafa 62 maloom elements mein periodicity dekhi. Barhte atomic masses ki tarteeb mein har aathwan element pehle se properties mein milta tha, aur us ne isi tarah groups banaye.

Mendeleev (1869): periodic table ka baap. Us ne 63 elements ko barhte atomic mass se aath vertical columns mein rakha aur milti julti properties wale elements ko groups mein. Us ne na-daryaft elements ke liye khaali jagah chhori aur un ke atomic mass aur properties ki pesh-goi ki jo sahi sabit hui.

Lothar Meyer (1869): atomic weights aur atomic volumes ka graph banaya; un curves mein bhi periodicity nazar aayi.

book_ref.quote: Over time, more elements were discovered, prompting scientists to organize them systematically

blocks.prompt:
2 How did Moseley's work change the basis of the periodic table? State the Modern Periodic Law and explain it with an example. (4 marks)
(Moseley ke kaam ne periodic table ki buniyaad kaise badli? Modern Periodic Law bayan karein aur misaal se samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Moseley ka kaam (1913): Moseley ne X-ray emission se maloom elements ke durust atomic numbers nikale. Us ne atomic masses ki bajaye atomic numbers se tarteeb di, jis se Mendeleev ke table ki khamiyan door huin, aur periodic law badla.

Modern Periodic Law: "Elements ki physical aur chemical properties un ke atomic numbers ke periodic functions hain."

Wazahat: Atomic number atom mein protons ki tadaad hai. Yeh law periodic table ka cornerstone (buniyaadi pathar) hai: barhte atomic number ki tarteeb mein milti julti properties wale elements muqarrara faaslon par aate hain. Maslan sodium, potassium aur cesium lithium jaisi physical aur chemical properties dikhate hain kyun ke sab aik group mein hain.

Group aur period mein properties nizaam ke saath badalti hain kyun ke nucleus mein protons ahista ahista barhte hain aur naye shells judte hain.

book_ref.quote: This significant breakthrough led Moseley to modify the Periodic Law

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe the main features of the modern periodic table. (4 marks)
(Modern periodic table ki ahem khasoosiyaat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Is waqt 118 elements barhte atomic numbers ki tarteeb mein hain.
2. Saat horizontal rows (periods) aur atharah vertical columns (groups) hain. (Purane table mein 8 groups thay: aath A-groups aur das B-groups.)
3. Aik group ke elements ki chemical properties milti hain kyun ke valence electrons barabar hain; physical properties oopar se neeche ahista badalti hain.
4. Period mein baayen se daayen properties ahista ahista badalti hain.
5. Groups aur periods ke ilawa elements ko blocks (s, p, d, f), families aur categories (metals, non-metals, metalloids) mein bhi rakha jata hai taake samajhna aasaan ho.

book_ref.quote: The classification of elements in the modern periodic table helps in the easier understanding of their properties

blocks.prompt:
4 Explain the classification of elements into metals, non-metals and metalloids. Describe the position of each with respect to the stair-step line. (4 marks)
(Elements ki metals, non-metals aur metalloids mein taqseem samjhayein. Stair-step line ke lihaaz se har aik ki jagah bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Metals: woh elements jo electrons kho kar positive ions banate hain, maslan iron, copper, gold, silver.

Non-metals: woh elements jo electrons le kar negative ions banate hain, maslan chlorine, sulfur, phosphorus.

Metalloids (semimetals): kuch properties metals ki aur kuch non-metals ki; yeh table par metals aur non-metals ko alag karte hain.

Stair-step line: boron (B) se shuru ho kar Si, Ge, As, Sb aur Te se guzarti hui polonium (Po) tak jaati hai.
• Line ke baayen elements metals hain.
• Line ke bilkul daayen metalloids hain.
• Table ke door daayen non-metals hain.
• Hydrogen istisna hai: baayen hai magar metal nahi.

book_ref.quote: Elements can be broadly classified as metals, nonmetals and metalloids

blocks.prompt:
5 What are blocks of the periodic table? Describe the s, p, d and f blocks and the importance of knowing the block of an element. (4 marks)
(Periodic table ke blocks kya hain? s, p, d aur f blocks bayan karein aur element ka block jaanne ki ahmiyat batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Elements ko us subshell ki buniyaad par blocks mein rakha jata hai jis mein un ke valence electrons hon.

s-block: pehle do groups (1 aur 2); valence electrons s subshell mein.
p-block: group 13 se 18 tak ke elements, aakhri group ki inert gases samait.
d-block: table ke darmiyan transition elements.
f-block: table ke neeche do series, lanthanides aur actinides.

Ahmiyat: Block jaanne se element ki khasoosiyaat, chemical reactivity, oxidation states, electron bharne ki tarteeb aur electronegativity aur ionization energy jaisi properties ka pata chalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Elements in the periodic table can be classified based on the subshells containing their valence electrons

blocks.prompt:
6 Describe the alkali metals and alkaline earth metals, giving the reason for their names, examples and properties. (4 marks)
(Alkali metals aur alkaline earth metals bayan karein: naam ki wajah, misalein aur properties.)
blocks.explanation: Alkali metals (group 1) paani se alkalis banate hain aur alkaline earth metals (group 2) zameen mein milte hain aur alkalis banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Sodium and potassium are notable examples of these elements

rows: Periodic table ka group 1.
Periodic table ka group 2.
Naam is liye ke paani se react kar ke alkalis banate hain.
Naam is liye ke zyada tar zameen mein milte hain aur alkalis banate hain.
Members: Li, Na, K, Rb, Cs, Fr; maslan sodium, potassium.
Members: Be, Mg, Ca, Sr, Ba, Ra; maslan calcium, magnesium.
Aik valence electron.
Do valence electrons, is liye divalent.
Kam density aur nisbatan kam melting point.
Metallic solids, alkali metals se zyada sakht aur dense.
Kam ionization energy; sab se reactive metals.
Aasani se oxidize hote hain; thermal aur electrical conductivity zyada.

blocks.prompt:
7 Describe the transition elements, chalcogens, halogens and noble gases as families of the periodic table. (4 marks)
(Periodic table ki families ke taur par transition elements, chalcogens, halogens aur noble gases bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Transition elements: sab se badi family, table ke darmiyan; d-block ki chaar series aur lanthanides aur actinides (f-block). Thermal aur electrical conductivity zyada, melting point zyada, density zyada, oxidation states badalti hain aur aksar rangeen compounds bante hain. Members: Sc, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn.

Chalcogens (group 16): naam is liye ke copper (Greek chalkos) ki zyada tar ores oxides ya sulfides hain. Oxygen aur sulphur non-metals, Se, Te, Po metalloids aur livermorium metal hai.

Halogens (group 17): non-metals (F, Cl, Br, I, At, Ts). Halogen ka matlab "salt-former" (namak banane wala) kyun ke yeh alkali aur alkaline earth metals se mustahkam halide salts banate hain. Bohat reactive, electron affinity zyada, aur aik electron le kar shell mukammal karte hain.

Noble gases (group 18): He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe, Rn, Og, bilkul daayen. Mukammal bahar wale shell ki wajah se taqreeban ghair-reactive aur monoatomic. Kuch compounds maloom hain, maslan XePtF₆, is liye naam inert gases se noble gases kar diya gaya.

book_ref.quote: The term “halogen” means “salt-former”

blocks.prompt:
8 Explain how the period number, group number and block of an element are related to its electronic configuration. Write the configuration of an element of period 3 and group 13. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke element ka period number, group number aur block us ki electronic configuration se kaise jude hain. Period 3 aur group 13 ke element ki configuration likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Period number: principal quantum number n yani nucleus ke gird shells ki tadaad batata hai. Period 3 ke element ke teen shells hain aur valence electrons teesre shell mein.

Block: valence electrons ka subshell block (azimuthal quantum number) par munhasir hai. Period 3 ke s-block element ke valence electrons 3s mein.

Group number: valence electrons ki tadaad batata hai. Period 3, group 2 (s-block) ke element ke 3s mein do valence electrons; yeh magnesium hai.

Misaal, period 3 aur group 13: group 13 yani 3 valence electrons; period 3 yani teen shells, is liye 3 valence electrons teesre shell mein:
1s² (pehla shell)   2s² 2p⁶ (doosra shell)   3s² 3p¹ (teesra shell)

Is tarah element ki jagah us ki electronic configuration samjhati hai, jo chemical rawaiye ko samajhne ke liye zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: Understanding the periodic arrangement of elements provides an explanation of an element’s electronic configuration

blocks.prompt:
9 Define atomic radius. Name the factors affecting it and explain its variation across a period and down a group. (4 marks)
(Atomic radius ki definition likhein. Is par asar karne wale factors batayein aur period aur group mein is ki tabdeeli samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Atomic radius atom ke size ka paimana hai; aapas mein bonded do aik jaise atoms ke darmiyan faasle ka aadha. Yeh bond ki qisam (covalent, metallic, van der Waals) ya atom ki haalat se badal sakta hai aur pm ya Å mein naapa jata hai.

Factors: atomic number, effective nuclear charge aur andar wale electrons ka shielding effect.

Period mein (baayen se daayen): atomic radius aam taur par kam hota hai. Nuclear charge barhta hai aur naya shell nahi judta, is liye electron cloud nucleus ke qareeb kheench liya jata hai.

Group mein (oopar se neeche): atomic radius barhta hai. Naye shells judte hain aur zyada shielding atom ko bada karti hai; nuclear charge ka izafa is par haavi nahi hota.

book_ref.quote: The atomic radius is typically measured in picometers (pm) or Angstroms (Å)

blocks.prompt:
10 What is ionic radius? Explain why a cation is smaller and an anion larger than the parent atom, and describe the trends of ionic radius in the periodic table. (4 marks)
(Ionic radius kya hai? Wazahat karein ke cation apne atom se chhota aur anion bada kyun hota hai, aur periodic table mein ionic radius ke trends bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ionic radius: crystal lattice mein ion ke size ka paimana; ion ke nucleus se bahar wale shell tak ka faasla, pm ya Å mein.

Cation: Atom electrons kho kar positive ion bane to neutral atom se chhota ho jata hai. Electrons khone se repulsion kam hota hai aur baqi electrons nucleus ke qareeb kheench liye jaate hain.

Anion: Atom electrons le to neutral atom se bada ho jata hai. Naye electrons repulsion barhate hain, nucleus ki kashish kam hoti hai aur electron cloud phail jata hai.

Period mein: cations ka ionic radius kam hota hai kyun ke barhta nuclear charge electrons ko qareeb kheenchta hai; anions ka bhi isi wajah se kam hota hai.

Group mein neeche: cations aur anions dono bade hote hain kyun ke principal quantum number n barhta hai aur shells judte hain. Bahar ke electrons door ho jaate hain jo nuclear charge ke izafe par haavi hai.

book_ref.quote: The ionic radius is a measure of the size of an ion in a crystal lattice

blocks.prompt:
11 Define first, second and third ionization energies, taking calcium as the example. How many ionization energies can an element have? (4 marks)
(Calcium ki misaal le kar first, second aur third ionization energies ki definition likhein. Aik element ki kitni ionization energies ho sakti hain?)
blocks.explanation:
First ionization energy (ΔHᵢ₁): gaseous haalat ke aik mole atoms ke har atom se aik electron nikal kar aik mole gaseous 1+ ions banane ki energy.
Na(g) → Na⁺(g) + e⁻   ΔHᵢ₁ = 494 kJ mol⁻¹
Ca(g) → Ca⁺(g) + e⁻   ΔHᵢ₁ = 590 kJ mol⁻¹

Second ionization energy (ΔHᵢ₂): gaseous 1+ ions ke aik mole ke har ion se doosra electron nikalne ki energy.
Ca⁺(g) → Ca²⁺(g) + e⁻   ΔHᵢ₂ = 1150 kJ mol⁻¹

Third ionization energy (ΔHᵢ₃): gaseous 2+ ions ke aik mole ke har ion se teesra electron nikalne ki energy.
Ca²⁺(g) → Ca³⁺(g) + e⁻   ΔHᵢ₃ = 4940 kJ mol⁻¹

Ionization energies ki tadaad: aik element ki kai ionization energies hoti hain; un ki tadaad us ke atomic number ke barabar hai (har electron ki aik).

book_ref.quote: The energy needed to remove one electron from each atom in one mole of atoms of the element in the gaseous state

blocks.prompt:
12 The first, second and third ionization energies of calcium are 590, 1150 and 4940 kJ mol⁻¹. Calculate (i) the energy needed to convert 2.5 mol of Ca(g) into Ca²⁺(g), and (ii) the energy needed to convert 0.5 mol of Ca(g) into Ca³⁺(g). (4 marks)
(Calcium ki first, second aur third ionization energies 590, 1150 aur 4940 kJ mol⁻¹ hain. (i) 2.5 mol Ca(g) ko Ca²⁺(g) banane ki energy, aur (ii) 0.5 mol Ca(g) ko Ca³⁺(g) banane ki energy maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Lagataar ionization energies jama hoti hain: Ca²⁺ ke liye do electrons, Ca³⁺ ke liye teen; phir moles se zarb dein.

book_ref.quote: Removal of a third electron from each ion in a mole of gaseous 2+ ions corresponds to the 3rd ionization energy

steps: (i) Aik mole ke liye Ca(g) → Ca²⁺(g) + 2e⁻: 590 + 1150 = 1740 kJ mol⁻¹
(ii) Aik mole ke liye Ca(g) → Ca³⁺(g) + 3e⁻: 590 + 1150 + 4940 = 6680 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
13 The first ionization energy of sodium is 494 kJ mol⁻¹. Calculate the energy required to convert 4.6 g of gaseous sodium atoms into Na⁺(g) ions. (Molar mass of Na = 23 g mol⁻¹) (4 marks)
(Sodium ki first ionization energy 494 kJ mol⁻¹ hai. 4.6 g gaseous sodium atoms ko Na⁺(g) ions banane ke liye kitni energy chahiye? (Na ka molar mass = 23 g mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Mass ko moles mein badlein, phir per mole energy se zarb dein.

book_ref.quote: to form one mole of gaseous 1+ ions is known as 1st ionization energy

steps: Na(g) → Na⁺(g) + e⁻   ΔHᵢ₁ = 494 kJ mol⁻¹
Na ke moles = mass ÷ molar mass = 4.6 ÷ 23 = 0.2 mol

blocks.prompt:
14 Nitrogen has a higher first ionization energy than oxygen although oxygen has the greater nuclear charge. Explain this with the help of electronic arrangement and spin-pair repulsion. (4 marks)
(Oxygen ka nuclear charge zyada hone ke bawajood nitrogen ki first ionization energy oxygen se zyada hai. Electronic arrangement aur spin-pair repulsion ki madad se wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Electronic configurations:
₇N = 1s² 2s² 2px¹ 2py¹ 2pz¹   ΔHᵢ₁ = 1403 kJ mol⁻¹
₈O = 1s² 2s² 2px² 2py¹ 2pz¹   ΔHᵢ₁ ≈ 1314 kJ mol⁻¹

Electronic arrangement: Aadhe bhare aur poore bhare orbitals zyada stable hote hain, is liye un se electron nikalne ki ionization energy zyada hoti hai. Nitrogen ka 2p subshell aadha bhara (2p³) hai. Nitrogen ka nuclear charge oxygen se aik kam hai, magar aadhe bhare subshell ki zyada stability ki wajah se N se electron nikalna mushkil hai.

Spin-pair repulsion: Aik orbital mein do spin-paired electrons aik doosre ko dhakelte hain, is liye in mein se aik ko nikalna thoda aasaan hai. Oxygen ke aik 2p orbital mein do paired electrons hain; aik ko nikalne mein kam energy lagti hai. Nitrogen ke teeno 2p electrons unpaired hain; repulsion na hone se zyada energy lagti hai.

Is liye oxygen ki first ionization energy nitrogen se kam hai.

book_ref.quote: Nitrogen (N) has three unpaired electrons in its 2p orbitals

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: kitaab mein N aur O ki configurations aur O ki 1365 qeemat ghalat chhapi hain; durust N = 2s² 2p³, O = 2s² 2p⁴ aur O ki IE taqreeban 1314 kJ mol⁻¹ hai. Natija wahi hai: O ki IE N se kam.

blocks.prompt:
15 Define first and second electron affinity. Explain with equations why the first electron affinity of oxygen is negative but the second is positive, and find the net enthalpy change for forming the oxide ion. (4 marks)
(First aur second electron affinity ki definition likhein. Equations ke saath samjhayein ke oxygen ki first electron affinity manfi aur second positive kyun hai, aur oxide ion banne ki net enthalpy change maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
First electron affinity (ΔH°ₑₐ₁): standard haalat mein 1 mole gaseous atoms mein 1 mole electrons daal kar 1 mole gaseous uni-negative ions banne ki enthalpy change. Misaal:
Cl(g) + e⁻ → Cl⁻(g)   ΔH°ₑₐ₁ = −348.8 kJ mol⁻¹
Yeh energy 6.02 × 10²³ gaseous Cl atoms ke Cl⁻(g) banne par kharij hoti hai; energy kharij hone se nishan manfi hai.

Second electron affinity (ΔH°ₑₐ₂): standard haalat mein 1 mole uni-negative gaseous ions mein electrons daal kar 1 mole gaseous 2− ions banane ke liye darkaar energy.

Oxygen: neutral oxygen atom mein pehla electron daalne par energy kharij hoti hai:
O(g) + e⁻ → O⁻(g)   ΔH°ₑₐ₁ = −141 kJ mol⁻¹
Magar uni-negative O⁻ mein doosra electron daalne par energy jazb hoti hai:
O⁻(g) + e⁻ → O²⁻(g)   ΔH°ₑₐ₂ = +798 kJ mol⁻¹

O(g) + 2e⁻ → O²⁻(g) ki net tabdeeli:
ΔH°ₑₐ₁ + ΔH°ₑₐ₂ = (−141) + (+798) = +657 kJ mol⁻¹

book_ref.quote: The second electron affinity, ΔH°ₑₐ₂ is the amount of energy required to add electrons

blocks.prompt:
16 The first and second electron affinities of oxygen are −141 and +798 kJ mol⁻¹. Calculate the enthalpy change when 0.4 mol of gaseous oxygen atoms are converted into O²⁻(g) ions. Is energy released or absorbed? (4 marks)
(Oxygen ki first aur second electron affinities −141 aur +798 kJ mol⁻¹ hain. 0.4 mol gaseous oxygen atoms ko O²⁻(g) ions banane ki enthalpy change maloom karein. Energy kharij hoti hai ya jazb?)
blocks.explanation: Dono electron affinities jama kar ke per mole O²⁻ ki tabdeeli nikalein, phir moles se zarb dein; nishan batata hai kharij (−) ya jazb (+).

book_ref.quote: The net enthalpy change for the formation of the oxide ion (O²⁻) can be calculated

steps: Nishan positive hai, is liye energy jazb hoti hai

blocks.prompt:
17 The first electron affinity of chlorine is −348.8 kJ mol⁻¹. Calculate the energy released when 1.505 × 10²³ gaseous chlorine atoms are converted into Cl⁻(g) ions. (One mole contains 6.02 × 10²³ atoms.) (4 marks)
(Chlorine ki first electron affinity −348.8 kJ mol⁻¹ hai. 1.505 × 10²³ gaseous chlorine atoms ke Cl⁻(g) ions banne par kitni energy kharij hogi? (Aik mole mein 6.02 × 10²³ atoms hain.))
blocks.explanation: Atoms ki tadaad ko moles mein badlein, phir per mole kharij energy se zarb dein.

book_ref.quote: This is amount of energy released when 6.02 × 10²³ atoms of chlorine

steps: Cl(g) + e⁻ → Cl⁻(g)   ΔH°ₑₐ₁ = −348.8 kJ mol⁻¹
blocks.final_answer: 87.2 kJ energy kharij hoti hai (ΔH = −87.2 kJ)

blocks.prompt:
18 Define electronegativity and describe Pauling's scale. Explain the periodic trends of electronegativity in groups and periods, and why metals are electropositive. (4 marks)
(Electronegativity ki definition likhein aur Pauling scale bayan karein. Groups aur periods mein electronegativity ke trends samjhayein, aur metals electropositive kyun hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Electronegativity molecule mein atom ki shared electron pair ko apni taraf kheenchne ki taqat hai.

Pauling scale: Linus Pauling ne be-unit qeematon ka scale banaya jo alkali metals ke liye aik se thoda kam se fluorine ke liye zyada se zyada chaar tak hai. Zyada qeemat yani electrons ki zyada kashish.

Period mein: baayen se daayen electronegativity barhti hai kyun ke nuclear charge barhta aur size ghatta hai; maslan period 2 mein Li 1.0 aur F 4.0.

Group mein: oopar se neeche kam hoti hai kyun ke shells judne se size barhta aur shielding barhti hai; maslan halogens mein fluorine (4.0) se iodine (2.5): F > Cl > Br > I.

Metals aur non-metals: table ke baayen metals ki electronegativity non-metals se kam hai. Is liye metals nisbatan electropositive aur non-metals electronegative hain.

book_ref.quote: Higher electronegativity values signify a stronger attraction for electrons

blocks.prompt:
19 What is metallic character? Explain its variation across a period and down a group of the periodic table. (4 marks)
(Metallic character kya hai? Periodic table ke period aur group mein is ki tabdeeli samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Metallic character: element ka electrons khone ka rujhan. Table ke baayen elements noble gas configuration paane ke liye bahar ke electrons aasani se kho kar positive ions (metals) banate hain; daayen, khaas kar daayen kone ke, elements electrons le kar negative ions (non-metals) banate hain. Is liye metallic character zyada tar valence shell ki configuration par munhasir hai.

Period mein: nuclear charge barhta aur atomic size ghatta hai, is liye valence electrons zyada kheenche jaate hain. Electron cloud nucleus ke qareeb aata hai, electrons khona mushkil hota hai aur metallic character baayen se daayen kam hota hai.

Group mein neeche: atomic size aur shielding barhti hai, valence electrons par nucleus ki kashish kam hoti hai. Electrons khona aasaan, metallic character zyada aur element zyada reactive. Is liye cesium sodium ya lithium se kahin zyada reactive aur electropositive hai.

book_ref.quote: Hence one can conclude that the metallic character of an element largely depends on its valence shell electronic configuration

blocks.prompt:
20 Describe the burning of sodium and magnesium in oxygen. Give balanced equations, the conditions for sodium oxide and sodium peroxide, the flame colours and one use of magnesium. (4 marks)
(Sodium aur magnesium ke oxygen mein jalne ko bayan karein. Balanced equations, sodium oxide aur sodium peroxide ki sharait, sholon ke rang aur magnesium ka aik istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Sodium: Sodium oxygen mein sunehre peele shole se jal kar sodium oxide aur sodium peroxide ka safaid solid mixture banata hai. Khuli hawa mein zor se react kar ke peroxide banata hai:
2Na(s) + O₂(g) → Na₂O₂(s)
Khaas sharait, maslan kam O₂ ya zyada temperature, par sodium oxide banta hai:
4Na(s) + O₂(g) → 2Na₂O(s)
Isi reactivity ki wajah se sodium ko hawa se bachane ke liye kerosene oil mein rakha jata hai.

Magnesium: Magnesium oxygen mein tez safaid shole se jal kar safaid solid magnesium oxide deta hai:
2Mg(s) + O₂(g) → 2MgO(s)
Istemal: magnesium powder bohat tezi se tez safaid shole se jalta hai, is liye fireworks aur S.O.S. flares mein istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Sodium burns in oxygen with a golden yellow flame to produce a white solid mixture

blocks.prompt:
21 What are oxides? Define amphoteric oxides and explain the amphoteric nature of aluminium oxide with equations. Also show with equations that SiO₂ and SO₂ behave as acidic oxides towards bases. (4 marks)
(Oxides kya hain? Amphoteric oxides ki definition likhein aur aluminium oxide ki amphoteric fitrat equations se samjhayein. Equations se yeh bhi dikhayein ke SiO₂ aur SO₂ bases ke saath acidic oxides ki tarah amal karte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Oxides: oxygen ke doosre elements se reaction se bane binary compounds. Khasoosiyaat ke lihaaz se inhein neutral, amphoteric, basic ya acidic mein taqseem kiya jata hai.

Amphoteric oxides: woh oxides jo acids aur bases dono se react karte hain, yani haalat ke mutabiq acid ya base ki tarah amal karte hain.

Aluminium oxide: Al₂O₃ paani mein hal nahi hota magar dono se react karta hai:
• hydrochloric acid se, aluminium chloride aur paani:
Al₂O₃ + 6HCl → 2AlCl₃ + 3H₂O
• sodium hydroxide se, sodium aluminate aur paani:
Al₂O₃(s) + 2NaOH(aq) → Na₂Al₂O₄ + H₂O(l)

Bases ke saath acidic rawaiya: non-metals ke acidic oxides covalent bonds se jude hote hain aur bases se react karte hain.
SiO₂(s) + 2NaOH(aq) → Na₂SiO₃(aq) + H₂O(l)
SO₂(g) + 2NaOH(aq) → Na₂SO₃(aq) + H₂O(l)
Silicon dioxide acidic oxide hai kyun ke yeh bases se react karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The classification of oxides is done into neutral, amphoteric and basic or acidic based on their characteristics

blocks.prompt:
22 Distinguish between hydration and hydrolysis of the chlorides of period 3. Explain with equations and pH values why NaCl and MgCl₂ give nearly neutral solutions while AlCl₃ and SiCl₄ give acidic solutions. (4 marks)
(Period 3 ke chlorides ki hydration aur hydrolysis mein farq karein. Equations aur pH ke saath samjhayein ke NaCl aur MgCl₂ taqreeban neutral solutions kyun dete hain jab ke AlCl₃ aur SiCl₄ acidic solutions.)
blocks.explanation:
Hydration (neutral chlorides): Period 3 ke shuru mein sodium aur magnesium ke chlorides paani se react nahi karte. Solution mein musbat metal ions aur manfi chloride ions paani ke molecules se ghir jaate hain; yeh hydrated ions hain aur amal hydration hai. Solution neutral, pH 7 ke qareeb:
NaCl(s) → Na⁺(aq) + Cl⁻(aq)   (pH = 7)
MgCl₂(s) → Mg²⁺(aq) + 2Cl⁻(aq)   (pH = 6.5)
Group 1 aur group 2 ke chlorides bhi chand istisna ke saath neutral hain.

Hydrolysis (acidic chlorides): Aluminium se sulphur tak chlorides paani se react kar ke pH 7 se kam wala acidic solution banate hain; yeh hydrolysis hai. Hydrated Al³⁺ ion paani ke molecule se H⁺ alag karwata hai jis se solution acidic hota hai:
AlCl₃(s) + 3H₂O(l) → Al(OH)₃(s) + 3HCl(aq)
SiCl₄(l) + 2H₂O(l) → SiO₂(s) + 4HCl(aq)
PCl₃(l) + 3H₂O(l) → H₃PO₃ + 3HCl(aq)
Banne wala HCl in solutions ko acidic karta hai.

blocks.explanation: Period 3 mein oxides aur chlorides ionic se covalent ki taraf badalte hain.

book_ref.quote: This transition is a result of the increasing electronegativity and decreasing ionic character

rows: Oxides (maslan Na₂O) mein zyada ionic character.
Oxides (maslan SO₂) zyada covalent.
Oxides giant ionic lattices hain.
SO₂ jaise oxides covalent molecules hain.
Mukhalif charge wale ions mein mazboot electrostatic forces.
Molecules mein kamzor intermolecular forces.
Chlorides (maslan NaCl) zyada tar ionic.
Chlorides (maslan PCl₅) covalent.
O ya Cl ke saath electronegativity ka zyada farq.
Halogen ke saath electronegativity ka farq kam, is liye covalent character zyada.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Wajah: period mein baayen se daayen elements ki electronegativity barhti hai, is liye un ka O ya Cl se electronegativity ka farq kam hota jata hai; ionic character ghatta aur covalent character barhta hai.

blocks.prompt:
24 Define oxidation number. Explain the variation of oxidation numbers of period 3 elements in their oxides and chlorides. (4 marks)
(Oxidation number ki definition likhein. Period 3 ke elements ke oxides aur chlorides mein oxidation numbers ki tabdeeli samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Atom ka oxidation number (oxidation state) molecule ya ion mein us par formal charge hai. Ionic compounds mein yeh ion par aane wala charge hai.

Period 3: Period 3 ke element ka oxide ya chloride mein oxidation number bonding mein lage electrons ke barabar hai. Yeh hamesha positive hai kyun ke oxygen aur chlorine in tamam elements se zyada electronegative hain. Sab se zyada qeemat group number (kul valence electrons) ke barabar hai.
• Oxides: Na (Na₂O) ke +1 se S (SO₃) ke +6 tak: Na +1, Mg +2 (MgO), Al +3 (Al₂O₃), Si +4 (SiO₂), P +5 (P₄O₁₀) ya +3 (P₄O₆), S +6 (SO₃) ya +4 (SO₂).
• Chlorides: Na (NaCl) ke +1 se P (PCl₅) ke +5 tak: Mg +2 (MgCl₂), Al +3 (AlCl₃), Si +4 (SiCl₄), P +5 ya +3 (PCl₃), S +2 (SCl₂).

Badalte oxidation numbers: phosphorus aur sulphur khaali 3d orbitals mein electrons bhej kar octet barha sakte hain, is liye kai oxidation numbers dikhate hain. SO₂ mein sulphur +4 kyun ke sirf chaar electrons bonding mein; SO₃ mein +6 kyun ke chhe ke chhe.
